title: Bonsai 2.5 27B publisher sampling sets: settings applied, plain and -mtp packs
command: python -m kindi convert <file> --out pack; KINDI_DEVICE=cpu python tools/bonsai_sampling_bench.py --pack pack --out run-{base,mtp}.json --tokens 32
notes: Both 2.5 27B files, CPU engine, both publisher sets and three reasoning efforts; one seed per prompt so `low` is directly comparable with `xhigh`. The host was busy during the runs, so the recorded timings are not a performance measurement and no rate is quoted from them.
